subject: Renewal preparation: evidence scope, log retention alignment & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <security@greenpathhealth.com>, procurement@greenpathhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal preparation: evidence scope, log retention alignment & capacity uplift

Hi Samira / Procurement team —

As GreenPath's renewal approaches (term end: 2027-08-15), I wanted to align on two parallel items we typically handle together: the SOC 2 re-attestation evidence scope / retention window, and the requested capacity uplift you mentioned in the renewal intake form.

Key points / asks from our side:
- SOC 2 re-attestation: We will provide a bridge letter and the requested evidence bundle for the re-attestation window. To ensure we surface the right artifacts, can you confirm the retention window you need for audit logs? Our standard offering is 90 days; you indicated 12 months in the intake.
- Audit log delivery: we can provide sample CSV exports and a one-time bulk export to an S3 bucket you control (if preferred). We do not currently ship continuous streaming exports as part of hosted plans without a dedicated connector; we can scope that as an add-on.
- Capacity uplift & terms: Your renewal notes requested a 2x burst capacity uplift and a 20% seat increase. We can include a term amendment with a capacity reservation and a 12-month price guarantee. Ben (cc) can run the pricing/contract draft.

Proposed timeline (suggested):
- Confirm retention window and S3 export preference by 2027-06-30
- We deliver SOC2 bridge letter + sample logs by 2027-07-07 (attached as a stub)
- Contract amendment draft (including capacity and retention change) to you by 2027-07-12
- Target DocuSign execution before renewal date (2027-08-15)

Attachments (stubs): SOC2-2027-bridge-letter.pdf, audit-log-sample-2027.csv, amendment-draft-terms.docx

If you prefer a quick call instead, I can set up 30 min next week.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <security@greenpathhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenpathhealth.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal preparation: evidence scope, log retention alignment & capacity uplift

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifications from our security team:

1) Retention window: we need 12 months of immutable audit logs for the security-relevant events (authn/authz, admin configuration changes, data access events). Is Redwood able to mark exported logs as immutable or provide timeline-based WORM on the S3 export?

2) Granularity / schema: can you confirm the fields included in the audit-log-sample? We need user_id, timestamp (ISO8601), actor_ip, resource_path, action, request_id, and an outcome/result code.

3) Evidence: the bridge letter is useful; can you also provide the name and scope of the auditor that will sign the re-attestation, and an expected attestation date range? Our compliance window runs Oct 2026–Jun 2027, so we need the evidence to fully cover that period.

Finally, procurement: please include commercial terms for the capacity uplift and the seat increase with a 36-month option and a 12-month commitment option (we are evaluating both).

—Samira
Samira Khan
Director of Information Security
GreenPath Health
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — commercial & contract draft notes

Lauren / Grace —

Noted. Quick commercial thoughts to include in the amendment draft:
- Capacity uplift pricing: add a dedicated pool reservation priced at list * 0.88 for the first 12 months (to account for the 2x burst and predictability). After month 12, revert to standard dedicated pricing unless they convert to a longer reserved commit.
- Seat increase: for 12-month term option, price seats at current rate + 8%; for 36-month, offer flat price for 24 months then CPI-adjusted.
- Retention WORM: we can support exporting to customer S3. For immutability, we can export to an S3 bucket with Object Lock enabled on your side; Redwood can assist with a one-time copy that preserves timestamps. We should include a clause that continuous log immutability is the customer's responsibility unless they purchase the archival connector add-on.

I'll draft amendment language and hand to contracts — I'll include two commercial exhibits (12m vs 36m). Please confirm if we should propose the 36-month as preferred (deeper discount) or present both equally.

Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <security@greenpathhealth.com>, procurement@greenpathhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal preparation: evidence scope, log retention alignment & capacity uplift

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the details; answers below inline.

1) WORM/immutability for exports: Redwood will provide the audit-log export in newline-delimited CSV/JSON to an S3 bucket you control. To achieve WORM semantics, please enable S3 Object Lock with governance/compliance mode on your bucket. Redwood can push the initial export and verify object metadata, but the long-term immutability enforcement must be configured on your side. We'll document the export process in the evidence playbook.

2) Schema fields: confirmed — the sample includes user_id, timestamp (ISO8601), actor_ip, resource_path, action, request_id, outcome_code, and session_id. (See attached audit-log-sample-2027.csv). If you need additional fields, tell us which ones and we can include them in the export.

3) Auditor & attestation timing: our auditor for the 2027 re-attestation will be Meridian Assurance. We expect the attestation report to be dated Q3 2027 (target window: Aug–Sep 2027). We'll deliver the bridge letter now and the full attestation report as soon as it's issued.

Commercials & options: Ben will circulate two exhibits (12m / 36m). Our recommendation (for budget predictability and your stated growth) is the 36-month commit with the deeper discount; we can show the exact numbers in the amendment draft.

Next steps:
- Please confirm by 2027-06-30 whether GreenPath wants 12m vs 36m term option and whether you want us to push exports to S3 (and provide the bucket ARN).
- Ben will share the amendment-draft-terms.docx and the DocuSign link for review once you confirm term preference.

Attachments (stubs repeated): SOC2-2027-bridge-letter.pdf, audit-log-sample-2027.csv, amendment-draft-terms.docx

Best —
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
